title: Daftar Proses & Kueri Aktif (Active Processlist)
description: Menampilkan seluruh koneksi dan kueri yang sedang aktif berjalan. Membantu mendeteksi transaksi macet atau kueri lambat secara langsung.
sql:
SELECT ID, USER, HOST, DB, COMMAND, TIME, STATE, INFO
FROM information_schema.processlist
WHERE COMMAND != 'Sleep'
  AND INFO IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY TIME DESC;

title: Atasi Host Terblokir & Error Koneksi (Flush Hosts)
description: Mengatasi kendala klasik 'Host is blocked because of many connection errors' dengan mereset cache host dan menaikkan batas toleransi max_connect_errors.

title: Periksa & Naikkan Batas Koneksi Maksimal
description: Memeriksa batas kuota koneksi simultan MySQL dan meningkatkan kapasitasnya secara dinamis tanpa perlu merestart server.

title: Cari Tabel Berdasarkan Nama Kolom
description: Mencari nama tabel dan skema mana saja yang memiliki kolom tertentu di seluruh database MySQL.
sql:
SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE column_name = 'nama_kolom'
  AND table_schema = DATABASE() -- Atau ganti dengan 'nama_database' spesifik
ORDER BY table_name;

title: Informasi Versi Server & Mode SQL
description: Memeriksa versi detail server MySQL serta konfigurasi mode SQL aktif (seperti strict mode atau only_full_group_by) pada level global dan sesi.

title: Ukuran Seluruh Database MySQL
description: Menghitung kapasitas total seluruh database di server, merinci ukuran data mentah, ukuran indeks, dan total kapasitas dalam satuan Megabyte (MB).
sql:
SELECT table_schema AS database_name,
       ROUND(SUM(data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS total_size_mb,
       ROUND(SUM(data_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_size_mb,
       ROUND(SUM(index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb
FROM information_schema.tables
GROUP BY table_schema
ORDER BY total_size_mb DESC;

title: Rincian Ukuran Tabel Terbesar
description: Menampilkan ukuran total, estimasi jumlah baris data, serta ukuran indeks untuk 20 tabel terbesar pada database yang sedang aktif.
sql:
SELECT table_name,
       table_rows AS row_count,
       ROUND((data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS total_size_mb,
       ROUND(data_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS data_size_mb,
       ROUND(index_length / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS index_size_mb
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY total_size_mb DESC
LIMIT 20;

title: Tabel Tanpa Primary Key
description: Mendata semua tabel yang belum memiliki Primary Key, yang berisiko memperburuk performa replikasi database dan mesin penyimpanan InnoDB.
sql:
SELECT tab.table_schema, tab.table_name
FROM information_schema.tables tab
LEFT JOIN information_schema.table_constraints con
  ON tab.table_schema = con.table_schema
  AND tab.table_name = con.table_name
  AND con.constraint_type = 'PRIMARY KEY'
WHERE con.constraint_name IS NULL
  AND tab.table_schema = DATABASE()
  AND tab.table_type = 'BASE TABLE';

title: Transaksi Kunci Menggantung (InnoDB Lock Waits)
description: Menampilkan transaksi mana yang sedang memblokir transaksi lain beserta detail kuerinya. Sangat berguna untuk mendiagnosis kendala lock timeout.
sql:
SELECT 
  r.trx_id waiting_trx_id,
  r.trx_mysql_thread_id waiting_thread,
  r.trx_query waiting_query,
  b.trx_id blocking_trx_id,
  b.trx_mysql_thread_id blocking_thread,
  b.trx_query blocking_query
FROM sys.innodb_lock_waits w
INNER JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx b
  ON b.trx_id = w.blocking_trx_id
INNER JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx r
  ON r.trx_id = w.requesting_trx_id;
